head: ME
raw_text: Answer: Jane used journaling as a recurring coping mechanism to manage her stress. She started journaling in November 2024 to cope with emotional and financial stress, and continued to use it in 2025 to process emotions and manage work-related stress, indicating that journaling was an effective strategy for her.
